title: Crosscheck weighting
description: A weighting says how much each thing matters when the crosscheck scores aws_core against a reference. It is data, separate from the script, so different situations can use different weightings. Rules are tried in order and the first match wins; a thing no rule matches gets default_weight. A file may extend another: the parent's rules follow the child's.

status.description: Whether a human has reviewed the weights; the report repeats it.

extends.description: File name (in this directory) of the weighting this one builds on.

carto_label.description: fnmatch pattern over a Cartography node label.

tap_type.description: fnmatch pattern over an aws_core entity type.

attribute.description: fnmatch pattern over a security-attribute id.

cfn_type.description: fnmatch pattern over a CloudFormation type name in the coverage ledger (for example AWS::WAFv2::*). It reaches services neither side models yet.
